question: List the names of events that had more than 15 attendees and for which the associated advertisement budget has the lowest remaining amount among all advertisement budgets.

prediction.sql:
SELECT e.XCL_011
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001
JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  AND b.XCL_006 = (SELECT MIN(XCL_006) FROM budget WHERE XCL_004 = 'Advertisement')
GROUP BY e.XCL_010, e.XCL_011
HAVING COUNT(a.XCL_002) > 15
